# CWI Trust Fabric — llms.txt

> A cryptographic transparency log for Cumulative Web Inc. Every public
> claim the company makes is published here as a signed, hash-chained
> envelope. Verify any claim yourself with zero trust in us.

## Canonical resources

- Live log: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-trust-log/
- Achievements feed: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-trust-log/achievements.html
- Machine-readable achievements: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-trust-log/achievements.json
- Chain index: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-trust-log/claims/index.json
- Protocol spec: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-trust-log/TRUST-PROTOCOL.md
- Public key: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-trust-log/keys/ed25519.pub
- Zero-trust verifier: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-trust-log/verify.js
- Machine-readable: https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-trust-log/.well-known/agent-card.json
- Repo: https://github.com/CumulativeWebInc/cwi-trust-log

## Key facts (verified 2026-09-23)

- 11 signed claim envelopes (protocol trust/1.0), SHA-256 hash chain from
  GENESIS, Ed25519 signatures. All 11 verify PASS with verify.js.
- Chain tip: e6ed72e06b6ce45bd025da3a3c09a9be5331046c8a85e7edbc3ab7370fb61159
- Tiers: VERIFIED (evidence observed at issuance) only. No receipt -> never VERIFIED.
- The private signing key is never in the repo. Nothing here can sign — only verify.
- History is append-only: protocol upgrades never rewrite envelopes.

## Verify a claim in 3 steps

```bash
node verify.js https://cumulativewebinc.github.io/cwi-trust-log/claims/<claim_id>.json
```

verify.js is zero-dependency Node 18+. It checks the Ed25519 signature
over canonical payload bytes, recomputes the SHA-256 hash, and walks the
hash chain back to GENESIS. Exit 0 on PASS, 1 on FAIL.
